summary: Sparkline takes an optional `domain` for line and area. By default each sparkline stretches its own min to max over the full height, which is right for one read alone and wrong for a column of them: in the stand-in screen's keyword table, a flat 12 ↔ 13 drew like a crash beside a real rise. Pass one domain to every sparkline in the column so their slopes compare. It is widened to hold every value, so it never clips; columns ignore it, as they stand on zero.
